# `finance-charge` commands

## `finance-charge assess`

Assess finance charges on overdue customer balances as of a date (default today), by the company finance charge preferences: annual rate, minimum charge, grace days, the finance charge account, whether overdue finance charges are charged again, and whether days count from the due date or the invoice date. Finance charges are off until those are set with `company update`. Dry-run is the preview: every customer and job with a balance overdue past the grace period, with its overdue balance, last finance charge date, the documents and days charged, and the proposed charge (open balance x rate x days / 365 per document, days from the due date, or invoice date, or the last finance charge date when later; summed exactly, rounded once to the cent half to even, then the minimum). `has_unapplied_credits` marks a customer with payments or credits not yet applied, which are not subtracted: apply them first. Omit `customers` to assess every proposed customer, or name the ones to assess, each optionally with a changed `amount`. Each charge is one statement charge on the Finance Charge item (set up on first use on the finance charge account), dated the assessment date: Accounts Receivable is debited and the finance charge account credited, so it ages, shows on `report statement` and is paid like any other charge; void it with `statement-charge void`. A customer already charged as of the date is not charged again. A date in a closed period is refused.

A dry run previews the proposed result without saving it. Any proposed record IDs or posted status in that preview describe the prospective save, not an existing saved record.

| Contract | Value |
|---|---|
| Scope | company |
| Kind | write |
| Required role | standard |
| Capability | ledger.post |
| Feature | — |
| HTTP | `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/finance-charge.assess` |
| External binary body | none |

### CLI

`bookflow finance-charge assess --date 2026-07-31 --reason "Month-end finance charges" --company "Demo Plumbing Co" --json`

### MCP

The same example as complete `bookflow_run` arguments:

```json
{"command": "finance-charge assess", "input": {"date": "2026-07-31"}, "company": "Company ID or name", "dry_run": true, "reason": "Preview the requested change"}
```

### Input

| JSON field | CLI input | Type | Required | Nullable | Default | Description and constraints |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | `--date` | string \| null | no | yes | null | Assessment date: the charges are computed through it and dated on it. Omitted, today in the company's timezone. |
| `customers[].customer` | inside `--customers` JSON array | string | yes | no | — | Customer or job to assess, by id or full name.; minimum length 1; maximum length 1004 |
| `customers[].amount` | inside `--customers` JSON array | string \| null | no | yes | null | Charge to assess instead of the computed one, e.g. 4.50; above 0.00. |
| `mark_to_print` | `--mark-to-print` | boolean \| null | no | yes | null | Mark the charges to be printed; omitted, the company preference. |
| `memo` | `--memo` | string \| null | no | yes | null | What the customer reads on the statement; omitted, 'Finance charge'. |
| `expected_facts_fingerprint` | `--expected-facts-fingerprint` | string \| null | no | yes | null | The facts_fingerprint of the preview this assessment was decided from; a change since is refused with E_PREVIEW_STALE. |

### HTTP

Route: `POST /companies/{company_id}/commands/finance-charge.assess`

Send the input object as JSON. Authentication may instead come from a browser session cookie.

| Header | Requirement | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` | required for bearer clients | `Bearer <secret>` |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Name` | optional | Stable caller name recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Client-Version` | optional | Caller version recorded in audit |
| `X-Bookflow-Context-Encoding` | optional | percent-utf8: encode all reason, source-ref, directive, idempotency-key, client-name and client-version header values as UTF-8 percent encoding |
| `X-Bookflow-Company` | optional | If sent, must equal the company ULID in the route |
| `X-Bookflow-Reason` | conditional | Short reason; an agent or system write needs this or an active directive |
| `X-Bookflow-Source-Ref` | optional | Identifier of the source that triggered the write |
| `X-Bookflow-Directive` | conditional | Active directive code or id; alternative to reason for an agent or system write |
| `Idempotency-Key` | optional | Retry-safe key for this create command |
